name: com.miui.zeus.mimo.sdk.view.WebViewActivity
sdkName: Xiaomi Mobile Ads Alliance (Mimo Ad SDK)
description: When a user follows a Xiaomi MiMo ad or offer link, this screen loads the destination in the SDK's in-app browser and handles web navigation and downloads.
disableEffect: Xiaomi MiMo ad landing pages and their download links will no longer open in the app.
